notes: The funder gives subject lists per country, not per level or per university. Every distinct subject on the 9 Asian and 12 Pacific country lists (Samoa has two lists, foundation and open intake) is recorded once, with the sectors and countries it is recommended for in the detail text. Subjects marked postgraduate only or undergraduate only on a list are kept to that level.

Recorded 305 bachelor-level rows and 310 postgraduate rows. The postgraduate rows (the same list) are repeated under master, doctorate and postgraduate certificate/diploma because the funder's lists do not differ by postgraduate level; bachelor rows come only from countries open to undergraduate study (Timor-Leste, Kiribati, Naoero, Niue, North Pacific, Papua New Guinea, Samoa, Solomon Islands, Tonga, Tuvalu, Vanuatu).

Papua New Guinea's page names priority sectors, not subjects, and says all subjects approved for study in New Zealand under those sectors are available; those sectors are recorded as rows. For Papua New Guinea, bachelor's degrees in medicine (MBBS), law, engineering, primary and secondary teaching and nursing are not offered.

The funder does not support the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) at the University of Canterbury, or the Bachelor of Law at Victoria University of Wellington and the University of Auckland, for the Pacific and Timor-Leste lists.
